summary_zh: Bulma 是一个基于 Flexbox 的现代 CSS 框架，输出为单个 CSS 文件，不包含 JavaScript，可作为样式层配合项目自有 JS 使用。可通过 npm、Yarn、Bower、CDN 或直接导入 CSS 文件快速安装，也可下载 Sass 源码自定义变量。
audience_zh: 适合需要轻量样式层、希望自行管理 JavaScript 逻辑的前端开发者，以及使用 Vue、React、Angular 等框架并寻求 CSS 框架的项目；需要兼容较新版本主流浏览器、对旧版 IE 支持要求不高的团队。

evidence.quote: Modern CSS framework based on Flexbox
Bulma is a **modern CSS framework** based on [Flexbox](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/CSS_Flexible_Box_Layout/Using_CSS_flexible_boxes).
Bulma is a **CSS** framework. As such, the sole output is a single CSS file: [bulma.css](https://github.com/jgthms/bulma/blob/main/css/bulma.css)

There is **no** JavaScript included. People generally want to use their own JS implementation (and usually already have one). Bulma can be considered "environment agnostic": it's just the style layer on top of the logic.
